selection: Parent of the upstream Spring Boot 3 migration through the first stable 3.0.0 application. Chosen from POM commit history before reading the implementation or upstream tests.
deployment: Both sides on Temurin 17.0.21+9, original Maven runtime dependency graph, embedded server, default in-memory database, fresh database per run, UTC. One serial HTTP client, English locale.
questions: unchanged sources compiled against new runtime
upstream adapted application on its intended runtime
allowedChanges: framework and generated markup details outside the declared observations

productionWorkflows.action: Start the application and fetch the owner creation form.
productionWorkflows.acceptance: GET /owners/new returns 200 with firstName and telephone fields.

productionWorkflows.action: Submit the owner form with an empty last name and a nonnumeric telephone.
productionWorkflows.acceptance: The response redisplays the form with validation errors and does not create an owner with the submitted first name.

productionWorkflows.action: Submit a valid owner, follow the new owner's detail link and search by last name.
productionWorkflows.acceptance: A redirect identifies the saved owner. Its detail page contains the supplied name and phone number. Searching the unique last name retrieves that owner.

scoring: Freeze these three roots. Count each workflow once per deployment and compare incremental and clean results at equal scope. A missing build, failed startup or narrower controller-only result leaves the downstream workflow open. Record later discoveries and any adapter or intent interventions separately.
